creators.name: Nick Dekker (Breakfast With Nick) — Columbus/Ohio breakfast & travel food blogger
creators.credible: Long-track-record central-Ohio food writer: author of the History Press books 'Breakfast With Nick: Columbus' and 'Distinctly Columbus'; regular local-TV/radio breakfast segments. Findable content at a named mid-corridor place: full English breakfast at The Last Queen, Enon (breakfastwithnick.com/2024/02/29/the-last-queen-enon-ohio/, Feb 2024). Blog/track-record creator, not a follower-count viral account.
